summary: Resolved all 10 findings from the single permitted Sol/high requirements cold read, launch-fd2aeb490263442aa0921e7bd9c441a9. The confirmed specification, Decision 0073, amended story-plan candidate, and pending normal plan/decomposition/task recorders now define one consistent authority chain.
gaps: The authoritative spec, approved plan, decomposition, and task-plan chain no longer named one revision.
The active task handover still used the pre-renumbering combined-review and model-policy decision identifiers.
The settled Wait for all answer had no unambiguous execution-versus-transfer scope.
The specification's Main wording appeared to grant the coordinator human decision authority.
The writer boundary used canon in mutually incompatible ways for planning documents and delegated implementation.
Question consumption conflicted with Decision 0067 and the stale no-reuse text in Decision 0071.
Partial multi-question calls had no all-or-nothing authority rule.
Setup precedence and detected-host signals were not decision-complete.
Review rejection had incompatible combined-only versus combined-or-rejection source rules.
Active fixed-review migration was contradictory about copying versus fresh reassessment.
resolutions: The confirmed specification and architecture now have pinned current hashes in the exact amended story-plan candidate. This requirements pass precedes the required plan save; the normal plan approval, decomposition, and task-plan recorders will replace the stale protected chain in order without treating old proof as current.

The amended story and task candidates now assign Decision 0067 to round rebinding, 0068 to worker networking, 0069 to combined review, 0070 to model policy, 0072 to staged platform proof, and 0073 to round reuse plus future empty-frontier proof.

The confirmed specification and amended plan state that Decision 0064 permits unaffected dependency-ready execution while the recorded Wait for all answer governs only coordinator transfer until required structured and ordinary-chat exchanges close or cancel.
The specification now says Main carries and presents recorded intent and invokes owning recorders; the developer alone makes decisions and supplies acceptance, sign-off, and approval.

The specification now distinguishes ordinary versioned planning sources that Main may author during authorized planning from managed state that only owning recorders change and post-approval product or enduring documentation that requires the registered task-writer path.
Accepted Decision 0073 supersedes Decision 0071's stale no-reuse consequence, keeps Decision 0067 as the sole same-gate/story/task reuse rule, and preserves the future empty-frontier exception.
A structured call is now atomic for authority: every question must return one nonblank answer or no partial answer from the call is eligible.

Setup now uses exact first-applicable tiers and concrete host signals: CODEX_THREAD_ID or CODEX_SHELL detects Codex and CLAUDECODE detects Claude; a valid higher tier suppresses lower disagreement, while both or neither host reaches TTY.

The specification, architecture, and task candidate now allow a rejection successor from the selected combined or rejection generation and preserve the immediate source plus combined root; all invalid source states refuse unchanged.

Portable migrates only sealed fixed sets. An active fixed set is excluded and must receive a fresh ordinary combined review against current task state; a sealed reader follows a later upgrade pointer only with an exact immutable marker binding.

rounds.question: Dual-coordinator review migration: should Forge remove ongoing fixed-path review compatibility and use one Portable-owned upgrade migration into canonical task-scoped selected review sets?
